name: Diamond Biofund Inc.
summary: Diamond Biofund Inc. is a venture capital firm specializing in evergreen funds. The firm seeks investment in start-ups and early ventures. It typically invests in biotechnology and medical investments, including new drug R&D, high-end medical equipment, innovative medical services and channels, and agricultural biotechnology. Diamond Biofund Inc. was founded in 2013 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
